item.text: The existing frontend and evaluator are present, but the scoped run exposed concrete stream-core defects: object construction collapses multiplicity, builtin arguments take only first outputs, and empty-driven updates don’t delete paths. I’m correcting those semantics now and adding the missing core control hooks that the declared stream/backtracking cases exercise.
